purpose: Test whether the homepage makes Jamie an easy, truthful yes for a rushed hiring reader through clear orientation, credible public-service value, visual authority, and decisive editorial selection.

pageBrief.audience: A rushed hiring reader considering Jamie for technical project management, product operations, implementation, civic technology, or adjacent public-interest work.
pageBrief.readerJob: Understand Jamie's role, value, evidence, and strongest next action in ninety seconds, then find deeper proof without decoding insider language.
requiredIdeas: Jamie turns important, loosely defined work into usable operating structure.
The public-service, operating, implementation, and participation claims are supported by inspectable project evidence.
The homepage offers one three-route orientation point and a deliberately selected project sequence.
Collective work remains collectively credited and modeled page-owner review remains distinct from real participation or endorsement.

allowedInputs: the exact rendered public homepage beginning at /
public pages reached by following homepage links
the page brief in this contract
the assigned owner's listed public sources
execution.disclaimer: Fictionalized analytical lenses informed by public work. These are not quotations, participation claims, approvals, endorsements, or predictions by the real people named.

owners.name: Cyd Harrell
owners.task: Evaluate only whether a rushed hiring reader can connect Jamie's stated value to credible public-service and delivery evidence and choose a useful next action.
owners.criterion: The first viewport identifies Jamie's role and value plainly; the next visible evidence makes the value credible without overclaiming authority or solo causality; and a hiring reader can reach role-fit proof or a resume within ninety seconds.

definitions.pass: A first-time reader can explain what Jamie would make more usable, cite at least two credible proofs, and take a relevant next action without decoding the site.
definitions.fail: The proposition is abstract, evidence is delayed or overclaimed, public-service value is vague, or the next action is unclear.

developmentExamples.label: clear-pass
developmentExamples.inputSummary: Role, value, two bounded proofs, and the role-fit path are legible within ninety seconds.

developmentExamples.label: clear-fail
developmentExamples.inputSummary: The page describes systems thinking but never shows a delivered result or a useful hiring action.

developmentExamples.label: borderline-fail
developmentExamples.inputSummary: Proof exists, but the reader must infer Jamie's role or mistake coalition outcomes for solo causality.

owners.name: Abby Covert
owners.task: Evaluate only whether the homepage gives a first-time reader a coherent mental model and a small set of distinct, understandable routes.
owners.criterion: Identity, capabilities, proof, selected work, and navigation use understandable categories; one three-route orientation point governs the opening; and interactive elements lead somewhere useful without redundant or competing calls to action.

definitions.pass: A first-time reader can state who Jamie is, what Jamie does, why it matters, and which of three distinct paths to take next.
definitions.fail: The page uses insider taxonomy, duplicated routing, ambiguous links, or accumulated categories that make the reader construct the information architecture.

developmentExamples.label: clear-pass
developmentExamples.inputSummary: One three-route Quick Path orients the reader and every later link deepens a clearly named category.

developmentExamples.label: clear-fail
developmentExamples.inputSummary: Hero buttons, a route list, menu links, and tags compete as simultaneous primary navigation.

developmentExamples.label: borderline-fail
developmentExamples.inputSummary: All links work, but overlapping labels leave the reader unsure which destination is primary.

owners.name: Michael Bierut
owners.task: Evaluate only whether the homepage's image, typography, hierarchy, and responsive composition create a distinctive identity that strengthens the professional argument.
owners.criterion: The hero remains memorable and readable on desktop and mobile; project imagery has useful variety and proportion; and repeated modules do not flatten distinct accomplishments into an undifferentiated feed.

definitions.pass: The composition feels authored, preserves legibility across viewports, and makes the strongest project evidence visually memorable.
definitions.fail: The page feels generic, imagery competes with comprehension, mobile cropping or contrast breaks, or repeated treatments flatten the work.

developmentExamples.label: clear-pass
developmentExamples.inputSummary: A distinctive hero leads to a concise, varied evidence sequence whose hierarchy survives mobile.

developmentExamples.label: clear-fail
developmentExamples.inputSummary: A generic hero and six identical long cards make every project look interchangeable.

developmentExamples.label: borderline-fail
developmentExamples.inputSummary: The desktop hero is strong, but a long uniform mobile feed erases the project hierarchy.

owners.name: Deborah Treisman
owners.task: Evaluate only whether the homepage selects and orders its material into a lucid, proportionate hiring narrative.
owners.criterion: The page progresses from identity and orientation through proof, capability, representative work, method, and contact; every section adds a consequence; unequal material receives unequal emphasis; and the central thesis is not repeatedly summarized.

definitions.pass: A first-time reader can follow the argument, remember the strongest evidence, and reach the close without encountering an accumulated or repetitive sequence.
definitions.fail: The page repeats its thesis, gives equal weight to unequal material, reprises the same project, or makes the reader find the story within accumulated modules.

developmentExamples.label: clear-pass
developmentExamples.inputSummary: Each section advances the story and three ranked projects lead with distinct, memorable consequences.

developmentExamples.label: clear-fail
developmentExamples.inputSummary: Four opening summaries precede six equally weighted cards and a repeated feature of the same project.

developmentExamples.label: borderline-fail
developmentExamples.inputSummary: All material is relevant, but repetition and equal card length bury the strongest evidence.

outputSchema.critique: A concrete assessment citing visible rendered-page evidence.
outputSchema.recommendedRevision: The smallest useful change, or No revision needed.
